Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the sources by excluding Delmer Daves’s producer role despite Britannica identifying him as a “Screenwriter, Director & Film Producer,” and then introduced an arbitrary “scope_index” based on number of directing credits to break a non-existent tie. This deviated from the task’s focus on breadth of professional roles and led to the incorrect conclusion that Phil Rosen had a broader scope, whereas Daves (screenwriter, director, producer) clearly has more scope than Rosen (director, cinematographer).
